```lean
:= by
  have h1 : (a + b) * (1 / a + 1 / b) = 2 + a / b + b / a := by
    rw [mul_add, add_mul, mul_one, one_mul]
    ring
  have h2 : a / b + b / a ≥ 2 := by
    apply add_right_inj (2 : ℝ)
    have h3 : a / b ≥ 0 := by
      rw [div_nonneg ha hb]
      exact (mul_pos ha hb).trans (le_rfl)
    have h4 : b / a ≥ 0 := by
      rw [div_nonneg hb ha]
      exact (mul_pos hb ha).trans (le_rfl)
    exact (add_nonneg h3 h4).trans (le_rfl)
  rw [h1]
  apply add_right_inj (2 : ℝ)
  exact h2
```
